_comment_types: ts/tsconfig.base.json sets lib: ["ES2022"] and no types, under which Headers, fetch and ReadableStream do not exist. `types: ["node"]` supplies them WITHOUT pulling in the DOM lib. This package is server-only composition, the way @paigasus/sdk's is — its own boundary rule bans react-dom and next/navigation from src/ — so there is no `jsx` option and `src/**/*` itself needs no DOM lib to catch a stray `window` or `document` reference. Matches ts/packages/paigasus-sdk/tsconfig.json.
_comment_include: tests/ and vitest.config.ts must be in the program: ts/eslint.config.js applies type-checked rules with projectService:true to every **/*.{ts,tsx}, and `ts:lint` runs `eslint .` over the whole tree — a file in no program errors there. Same shape and reason as ts/packages/paigasus-discovery/tsconfig.json.
